items.title: Developer or AI Manager?
items.pt:
I've noticed something changing in the way I write code.

I still code, obviously. But more often now, part of the job looks like this:


Explain what I want.
Give an AI tool enough context.
Let it generate something.
Read the code carefully.
Figure out what it misunderstood.
Ask it to fix part of it.
Run the tests.
Then sometimes rewrite the important bits myself.


And that made me wonder:


Are developers slowly becoming managers of AI agents rather than people who primarily write code?


I d
